limits: Static metadata/source inventory, not a new execution run or complete operation-parity proof.

Origin extraction follows explicit guards and same-pallet helpers receiving origin; unresolved/adapter paths require review. Existing business-state, proxy and security-floor restrictions still apply.
Regressions use runtime/pallet test environments with explicit test weights. A targeted regression only proves the scope named in its entry.
No call has been exercised as an activated production ML-DSA finalized transaction; compiled production weight/activation gates remain closed.
No complete per-call direct/proxy/all-PQ/mixed-multisig matrix, historical-upgrade UI/indexer matrix, or physical hardware signing is established by this report.

R01.scope: Executive: classical sponsor registers/funds ML-DSA atomically; new account subsequently signs.
R01.execution: Referenced by the separately reported full Rust suite; this inventory script does not run tests.

R02.scope: Executive: mixed/all-PQ 2-of-2 approvals, protected registration and transfer; stable account and call hash. Not every threshold/cancel route.
R02.execution: Referenced by the separately reported full Rust suite; this inventory script does not run tests.

R03.scope: Executive: ML-DSA delegate transfer and identity/generation checks; classical delegate rejected.
R03.execution: Referenced by the separately reported full Rust suite; this inventory script does not run tests.

R04.scope: Executive: protected derivative/pure creation, failed child rollback, pure destruction retains protection.
R04.execution: Referenced by the separately reported full Rust suite; this inventory script does not run tests.

R05.scope: Runtime dispatch: restricted direct/batch/nested proxy routes cannot reserve protected deposits; Any control succeeds.
R05.execution: Referenced by the separately reported full Rust suite; this inventory script does not run tests.

R06.scope: Executive: carrier/inner generation lifecycle, malformed proof and replay rejection. Ciphertext framing is synthetic; not proposer decryption or finalized blocks.
R06.execution: Referenced by the separately reported full Rust suite; this inventory script does not run tests.

R07.scope: Executive: native EVM call/nonce for ordinary, hashed and ML-DSA wallets.
R07.execution: Referenced by the separately reported full Rust suite; this inventory script does not run tests.

R08.scope: Executive: EVM create address prediction with/without explicit nonce across wallet modes including ML-DSA.
R08.execution: Referenced by the separately reported full Rust suite; this inventory script does not run tests.

R09.scope: Executive: EVM create2 address and envelope fee across wallet modes including ML-DSA.
R09.execution: Referenced by the separately reported full Rust suite; this inventory script does not run tests.

R10.scope: Executive: authentication fee survives native EVM gas/refund accounting.
R10.execution: Referenced by the separately reported full Rust suite; this inventory script does not run tests.

R11.scope: Executive: EVM revert/invalid cases retain authentication fees and reject replay.
R11.execution: Referenced by the separately reported full Rust suite; this inventory script does not run tests.

R12.scope: Executive: wallet-mode matrix including ML-DSA for multisig and proxy transfers.
R12.execution: Referenced by the separately reported full Rust suite; this inventory script does not run tests.

R13.scope: Fee-extension test only: remove_stake quotation/charge for ML-DSA and forced inner failure; not successful unstaking parity.
R13.execution: Referenced by the separately reported full Rust suite; this inventory script does not run tests.

R14.scope: Runtime dispatch: capability/order batch failure rolls back real asset/fee/reserve state.
R14.execution: Referenced by the separately reported full Rust suite; this inventory script does not run tests.

R15.scope: Runtime dispatch: restricted proxy routes cannot approve orders/install spending capability; full authority control succeeds.
R15.execution: Referenced by the separately reported full Rust suite; this inventory script does not run tests.

R16.scope: Pallet mock: Root-only independent switches, registration/check behavior and persistent protection.
R16.execution: Referenced by the separately reported full Rust suite; this inventory script does not run tests.

R17.scope: Pallet mock: derived owner/payer consent and idempotent charging; not an outer ML-DSA transaction.
R17.execution: Referenced by the separately reported full Rust suite; this inventory script does not run tests.

R18.scope: Pallet mock: protected owner and independent install/revoke epochs.
R18.execution: Referenced by the separately reported full Rust suite; this inventory script does not run tests.

R19.scope: Pallet mock: original sequential/netted calls execute mixed classical/account-approved/ML-DSA orders atomically.
R19.execution: Referenced by the separately reported full Rust suite; this inventory script does not run tests.

R20.scope: Pallet mock: original cancellation clears approved remainder and preserves legacy semantics.
R20.execution: Referenced by the separately reported full Rust suite; this inventory script does not run tests.

R21.scope: Pallet mock: mismatched legacy/new proof modes and too many authorized entries fail closed.
R21.execution: Referenced by the separately reported full Rust suite; this inventory script does not run tests.

R22.scope: Pallet mock/codec: bounded proof decoding and exact signature length enforcement.
